display_text: Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) ** Adds [[Skills|Charisma Skills - Exceptional Bonus +2]][[Skills|Charisma Skills - Exceptional Bonus +2]]: Passive +2 [[Exceptional bonus]] to the [[charisma|Charisma]] based skills of: [[Bluff]], [[Diplomacy]], [[Haggle]], [[Intimidate]], [[Perform]] and [[Use Magic Device]] (UMD)[[Category:Charisma Skills - Exceptional Bonus +2 items]] ** [[Deception]][[Deception]]: This weapon is hard to focus upon and thus provides a +3 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, Deception weapons have a small chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.[[Category:Deception items]] → [[Deception#Improved Deception|Improved Deception]][[Deception#Improved Deception|Improved Deception]]: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.[[Category:Improved Deception items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
